integrationGates.purpose: event-driven, taught and optimized versions compose

rules.activation: only items in the next eligible wave may activate
rules.parallel: parallel-no-rebase means same base main SHA, disjoint authoritative change surfaces, no unmerged implementation dependencies, independently mergeable PRs
rules.contractDependencies: a frozen/merged contract is sufficient; no rebase onto another implementation branch
rules.integrationGates: combine already merged capabilities; never integrate by rebasing sibling branches
rules.completion: implementation + deterministic verification + required dogfooding + sole architect merge + actual merge evidence
rules.dogfooding: mandatory after every feature boundary and after declared cross-feature integration gates
rules.quality: parallelism must never reduce tests, real-system proofs, security checks, or dogfooding
rules.recovery: resume from exact repository state and recorded nextAction, never conversation memory
rules.scope: unrelated findings require separate corrective Work Orders; no drive-by fixes
rules.v1Boundary: V2 cannot silently replace or mutate frozen v1.0 authorities

nextAction: Activate W1 from the actual current main; V2-002, V2-003 and V2-004 start independently from the same main SHA and must not use one another's unmerged branches.
